planner_rules.note: Draft rules used by validator.py. All values are drafts (grade D) pending expert confirmation unless stated otherwise.

weekly_caps.note: total_sets = sum(sessions_per_week * sets) over reps/time rows; total_minutes = sum(sessions_per_week * minutes) over duration/ruck rows

weekly_progression.note: week N total must be <= max(week N-1 total * max_increase_ratio, week N-1 total + allowance). Decreases are always allowed.

allowed_equipment.source: draft; availability in unit gyms not confirmed

excluded_exercises.note: Registered in the catalog but not allowed in plans under this rule version. EX27 rucksack walking removed from plans; EX09 barbell back squat removed because plans carry no load prescription.

rep_cap_by_record.note: reps per set <= max(floor(current record * max_ratio_of_current), exercise dose reps minimum)
rep_cap_by_record.source: draft (submaximal sets relative to current 2-min record)

run_quality.note: If 3km needs improvement, every week from from_week needs at least one high-intensity run (interval or tempo).

final_week_taper.note: Last week's total sets and total minutes must not exceed the previous week's (eases load before the fitness test).

ruck.source: draft; load fixed at 15kg by spec

coverage.note: Each improvement column with delta != 0 needs at least one row per week whose targets include it. load_carriage (secondary goal) must be targeted in at least min_weeks_with_load_carriage weeks.

explanation.note: Numbers in reasons/summary must come from: deltas (signed and absolute), current/goal records, soldier attributes, load ratio (and x100), the row's own prescription and week, or allowed_constants.
explanation.note_patterns: '세트 4회, 28회' is confused with sessions per week; write '4세트 28회'.
explanation.note_unique: Reasons for the same exercise must differ across weeks even after masking numbers.
